title: Meliorat
description: Meliorat brings many improvements to vanilla minecraft, expanding upon existing features.
body:
# Meliorat

Meliorat is a vanilla+ Minecraft mod focused on improving overlooked mechanics and giving more purpose to underused features.

## Current additions include:

- Functional Fletching Table recipes
- Better use for Ocelots
- Expanded Sniffer rewards
- Dolphin-guided reef exploration
- New Cauldron interactions
- Placeable clocks
- And more

Meliorat aims to feel like a natural extension of Minecraft rather than a separate progression system.

## Credits

Special thanks to Nekoma for inspiring many of the ideas currently implemented in Meliorat, with likely more to come in future updates.

I discovered these ideas through Nekoma's Minecraft feature concept videos and adapted some of them into a playable modding format.

Feature Inspiration Video (Meliorat 1.0.0):
https://youtu.be/DJJyutHL47M?si=weptnwYuGDBLxTC6

Nekoma's Homepage:
https://www.youtube.com/@Nekoma7

## Important

This is not a collaboration, partnership, or official project involving Nekoma.

Meliorat is an independent fan project. All inspiration comes solely from publicly available videos, and I have had no involvement, communication, or coordination with Nekoma regarding the development of this mod.

NOTE - Not every feature is 1:1 to the video.
